verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 7.7, Links row: 'internal links checked by the build; external links checked weekly by links.yml, where a failure opens an issue and does not fail a build'; 7.8 'links.yml runs weekly (section 7.7)'; 9.1 phase 0 Builds: 'the three workflows of section 7.8'. The passage supports the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: Gate commit b9b8504, read with git show. .github/workflows/links.yml has not changed since 278495a (P0-A1: scaffold), and it is the same file at aea18020, the head of the GitHub run. The lychee args are "--no-progress --exclude 'localhost' --exclude '^https?://[^/]*github\.io/' --exclude-path 'site/dist/_astro' 'site/dist/**/*.html'", with no --root-dir, --base or --scheme. The issue step runs 'gh issue create ... --body-file lychee-report.md'. GitHub (read only): links run 39258486524 is the only links run (total_count 1); it was a schedule run on 2026-10-19 at head aea18020 and ended in failure. Its one job is 118079714433; the finding's '118079079714433' is a typo. In that job, step 'Check external links' shows success only because of continue-on-error. Its log has many lines like "[ERROR] <error:> ... Cannot resolve root-relative link '/mutation_game/credits/': To resolve root-relative links in local files, provide a root dir" (also for _astro CSS and /mutation_game/katex/0.16.47/katex.min.css), then 3 real external TIMEOUTs and '##[error]Process completed with exit code 2.' Step 'Open an issue on failure' failed with 'GraphQL: Body is too long (maximum is 65536 characters) (createIssue)', so no issue was opened. 'Every week' extrapolates from one run, but the cause is fixed in the file. Records: DECISIONS.md 'P0-A1' describes links.yml and lychee-action@v2 and says 'RT-12 or the owner should confirm them on the first run'. It does not accept internal links being judged or the issue failing. The P0-A6 entry leaves only the internal half of the Links row open. Nothing on links.yml, lychee or the issue size appears in reports/gate-G4.md (report commit 4e3e839, whose gate line names b9b8504), in the round 1 JSON files, or in the round-p4 'Known and decided' list. RT-12 lens section 6 ('The workflows never having run ... Judge the workflow files statically') covers missing runs, not a broken workflow.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 no sentence permits it, because the Links row says without qualification that a failure opens an issue and only external links are in scope; R2 the finding reads 7.7 and 7.8 correctly; R3 links.yml is a phase 0 deliverable (9.1); R4 does not apply (no oracle); R5 7.7 has no [D] mark and the P0-A1 record names the action without accepting the gap; R6 no record in gate-G4.md, the round 1 files or the known-and-decided list. Major fits the rubric: a behaviour the specification states is wrong.

verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 7.2 item 10: 'otherwise, in CI, the values that follow from GITHUB_REPOSITORY (owner/repo gives https://owner.github.io and /repo/)'; 7.8: 'ci.yml runs on every pull request and on every push to the main branch: the tests of section 7.7'; 7.7 npm run e2e. The passages support the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: Read at b9b8504 (git show). site/tests/e2e/registry-weight.spec.ts:18 is "const dist = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../dist/', import.meta.url))". Line 36 is "if (u) roots.push(u.replace(/^\//, ''))" (only the leading slash is dropped). Line 46 is "readFileSync(join(dist, p), 'utf8')", with no existence check on the roots. site/astro.config.mjs siteAndBase gives base `/${repo}/` from GITHUB_REPOSITORY and never reads CI. ci.yml sets no BASE_PATH; its comment says 'BASE_PATH is not set here: the build, astro preview, the e2e baseURL and size.mjs all take the base from siteAndBase (GITHUB_REPOSITORY gives /<repo>/)'. Its steps are 'Preview build: npm run build' and then 'Browser tests: npm run e2e'. playwright.config.ts ignores only basepath.spec.ts when BASE_PATH is unset, so registry-weight.spec.ts runs in CI at /mutation_game/. Records: the DECISIONS.md entry 'RT-FIX-P3-perf-b: the browser never loads the tool registry (P3-RT-07-04)' says nothing about the base. No fragment limits e2e to the root base. gate-G4.md ran 'npm run e2e' locally at the root base (891 passed) and records no CI run. The last GitHub ci run (39042340476 at aea18020) does not contain this spec ('exists on disk, but not in aea18020'), so CI has no history for it. The test is the RT-FIX regression for P3-RT-07-04 and is present at G4, so it is not a later-phase item. For severity: 9.1 says 'The automatic part is a set of tests, run by the commands of section 7.7: in continuous integration once the repository is on GitHub'. DECISIONS.md P0-A1 says 'the owner merges it into main on GitHub', and ci runs already exist on johnjanik/mutation_game.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 no sentence limits e2e to the root base, and 7.2 item 10 and ci.yml's own comment put CI at /<repo>/; R2 the finding reads 7.2 item 10 and 7.8 correctly; R3 the spec is a regression test present at G4; R4 does not apply; R5 neither 7.7 nor 7.8 is [D] and no logged decision covers the base; R6 no record. If the claim holds, npm run e2e, a 7.7 command that 9.1 runs in CI once the repository is on GitHub, fails there. That is 'a gate command that fails', which RED-TEAM-COMMON 4 lists as a blocker.

verdicts.citation: CONTRACTS.md 1: package.json 'engines': {'node': '>=22.12'}; SPEC.md 7.1 [D] Node row: '22.12 or later (LTS line 22)'; 7.2 item 1: Astro 7 'requires Node 22.12 or later'; COMMON.md 3: 'Node must be 22.12 or later'. These admit 22.12 to 22.17, which the build does not support.
verdicts.evidence: Read at b9b8504. package.json has engines '>=22.12' and postbuild 'node scripts/links.mjs'. scripts/links.mjs:199, scripts/size.mjs:344 and scripts/lab.mjs:741 each run "await import(pathToFileURL(join(SITE_DIR, 'astro.config.mjs')).href)". site/astro.config.mjs:11 has "import { openItemsReportIntegration } from './src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts'" (there since bedcc94, phase 0). The build's own header in scripts/presets.mjs says 'Node 22.18 and later strip types by default ...; on Node 22.12 to 22.17 the script runs itself again once with --experimental-strip-types'. The plan for P4-A2, section 5.9, says 'on Node 22.12 to 22.17 the flag --experimental-strip-types is needed'. So the builders treated 22.12 to 22.17 as a supported range and handled it only in presets.mjs. DECISIONS.md 'P4-A2 (continuation): scripts/presets.mjs and how it loads the engine' records the re-execution for presets.mjs only. No entry raises engines or .nvmrc to 22.18, and none exempts links.mjs, size.mjs or lab.mjs. The [D] of 7.1 covers a choice within its text, and the text admits 22.12, so R5 does not apply. One ambiguity goes to the owner: the 7.1 column is 'Version to pin', and .nvmrc '22' resolves to a 22.18+ release in CI. But the engines field, COMMON 3 and the plan's own 22.12-to-22.17 branch all declare 22.12 supported. gate-G4.md recorded Node v22.22.0 only and has no note on this.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 no sentence permits a minimum above 22.12, and 7.1, 7.2 item 1, CONTRACTS 1 and COMMON 3 all say 22.12 or later; R2 the finding reads the engines contract correctly, and only the 'Version to pin' wording is ambiguous, with no sentence permitting the behaviour; R3 links.mjs in postbuild and size.mjs exist at G4; R4 does not apply; R5 the [D] of 7.1 admits 22.12 and no logged decision raises the minimum or exempts these scripts; R6 no record. Major fits: npm run build, size and lab fail on an admitted Node.

verdicts.citation: DECISIONS.md 'RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b: a complete release report (P3-RT-12-06)': 'Reason: a failed release build is never presented as the release report'; same fragment, 'the internal-link check of the build (P3-RT-12-01)': links.mjs runs as postbuild 'so a preview build, a release build ... all fail on a problem'; SPEC.md 7.7 'RELEASE=1 npm run build (a release build)'. The records support the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: Read at b9b8504. In site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts, 'astro:build:done' runs writeFiles(buildReport(mergedWithFile(), true)), which marks the report complete inside Astro. package.json then runs 'postbuild': 'node scripts/links.mjs' after the Astro build. scripts/report.mjs refuses a report only when it is missing, when mode is not 'release', when the .md is missing, or when 'report.complete !== true'. It never checks that the postbuild finished. SPEC 7.3 and 7.7 do not say what npm run report does after a failed release build; the P3-RT-12-06 decision itself says 'SPEC 7.3, 7.7 are silent'. The standard is therefore the logged decision, and its stated reason is broken when the release build fails in postbuild. Both decisions are in the same fragment, and neither accepts that a postbuild failure leaves complete: true. Section 9 of gate-G4.md has report exit 1 only because no release build ran. The round 1 files and the known-and-decided list are silent. This is a check that proves less than its record says (RED-TEAM-COMMON 2).
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 no sentence permits presenting a failed release build's report, and 9.1 G3 and G6 want 'a release build succeeds and prints its two reports'; R2 the finding quotes the decision's reason correctly and the postbuild is part of RELEASE=1 npm run build; R3 report.mjs, the complete marker and the postbuild all exist at G4; R4 does not apply; R5 the logged decisions record the mechanism, and their stated reason contradicts the behaviour; R6 no record. Minor fits, since SPEC is silent and the gap is in a check.

verdicts.citation: Logged decision, DECISIONS.md '2026-10-17 P4-A2 (continuation): scripts/presets.mjs and how it loads the engine': 'The hook maps `@engine` to `packages/engine/src/index.ts` ... Default used: the plan's (5.9)'. build-plan/agents/P4-A2-projector.md 5.9: 'register a resolve hook ... and resolves `@engine` to `packages/engine/src/index.ts`. Keep the hook in `scripts/presets.mjs` itself. ... Record the mechanism in the fragment.' CONTRACTS.md 1 gives the mapping only: '@engine → @two-games/engine'.
verdicts.evidence: Read at b9b8504. scripts/presets.mjs:46 is "if (specifier === '@engine') return engineIndex;", with ENGINE_INDEX = packages/engine/src/index.ts. This is the mapping the plan prescribes and P4-A2 logged (commits e02e0e3 and a297b6a, 07:49 on 2026-10-17). It agrees with CONTRACTS 1: packages/engine/package.json exports '.' as './src/index.ts', and site/tsconfig.json has "@engine": ["../packages/engine/src/index.ts"]. The 'one declaration' decision the finding relies on is narrower than the finding reads it. RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b (P3-RT-12-05, commit 0f0502d at 15:37, after presets.mjs existed) decides that 'the site-unit project of the root Vitest configuration ... resolves the aliases ... through resolve: { tsconfigPaths: true }'. It notes that 'CONTRACTS.md 1 gives the mapping only' and leaves other copies to their owners. The residual RT-FIX-P3-residual-tools (598e7c1, 2026-10-24) extends this to 'every test file and test configuration'. Its test 'no test file or test configuration declares the aliases again' scans site/tests and the Vitest, Playwright and Astro configurations by design, not scripts/. No later decision withdraws P4-A2's logged hook. The finding's own observed shows astro build exits 1 with the tsconfig '@engine' broken, so npm run build still fails on a broken declaration.
verdicts.reason: scripts/presets.mjs mapping '@engine' itself is the mechanism the P4-A2 plan (5.9) prescribed and P4-A2 logged in DECISIONS.md (R5, a logged decision under the P4 verify instructions). The 'one declaration' decisions the finding cites cover only the Vitest projects, test files and test configurations, and CONTRACTS 1 fixes only the mapping, which presets.mjs matches (R2).
